subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 Jalal is a rickshaw puller. One day, after carrying a passenger to a destination, he stood before a roadside tea stall. There a customer was reading a newspaper. Jalal requested the man to see the lottery draw.................
guide_solution: Story writing Jalal is a rickshaw puller. One day, after carrying a passenger to a destination, he stood before a roadside tea stall. There a customer was reading a newspaper. Jalal requested the man to see the lottery draw in the newspapaer The man thoroughly checked the results of the lottery again
